question: Under which licence is the Human Protein Atlas released?

turns.text:
The Human Protein Atlas is licensed under the **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0)** for all copyrightable parts of the database, though some included data may be subject to third-party constraints and licenses (such as data from external sources).

Source:
* [Human Protein Atlas: Licence & Citation](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence)
